span.p: loop

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: START ROUND r

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read committed state S(B_(r−1))
h_(r−1) · M_r · balances · pending transactions

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Build the COMMON canonical block template BlockTemplate_r
+ nonce-free HeaderTemplate_r
including the pre-committed reward transaction T_reward(r)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
All miners agree on
TemplateID_r?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reconcile transaction view · re-derive template
mining does not begin

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Round seed
seed_r = H(“PoColNonce” ‖ h_(r−1) ‖ r ‖ TemplateID_r)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deterministic miner ordering
ticket_r(mᵢ) = H(seed_r ‖ id(mᵢ)) → sorted list L_r

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Partition the permitted nonce domain N = 0 … N_max − 1
start_r(i) = ⌊ i·N_max/n ⌋ , end_r(i) = ⌊ (i+1)·N_max/n ⌋ − 1
R_r(m₍ᵢ₎) = [start_r(i), end_r(i)] , n = |M_r|

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PARALLEL DISJOINT SEARCH
each miner inserts only n ∈ R_r(mᵢ) into HeaderTemplate_r

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: H(Serialize(Header_r(n))) ≤ Target?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: Assigned ranges exhausted?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: Post-range policy: low-power idle · or continuous non-overlapping work

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NEW ROUND · new canonical template · new TemplateID
new seed · new nonce ranges

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: Publish the committed template instantiated with n_success

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
VERIFY · template conformity + TemplateID_r
+ n_success ∈ R_r(m_winner) + PoW ≤ Target
+ transactions + pre-committed reward

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
All checks pass and
chain selected?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: COMMIT block B_r to the chain

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pay the PRE-COMMITTED reward
Reward_r(mᵢ) = sᵢ · R_tot(r) , Σ sᵢ = 1
to every registered miner

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: Update state S(B_r) · update M_(r+1) · clear mempool

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p: r ← r + 1 · NEXT ROUND

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 620px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Common-Template Invariant: one immutable template per round —
only the nonce varies. Disjoint-Evaluation Invariant: R_r(mᵢ) ∩ R_r(m_j) = ∅,
so no two honest miners hash the same serialized candidate header.
